tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The page ground. Every screen starts here; nothing else is a page background.

tokens.name: canvas-raised
tokens.usage: Inset panels, code blocks and table stripes sitting on canvas. Separated from canvas by a rule, not by shade alone.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, body copy and every control border on canvas and canvas-raised. 16.5:1 on canvas in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting copy and the typewriter line on canvas and canvas-raised. 9.9:1 / 10.7:1 on canvas.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Meta text and inactive nav items on canvas and canvas-raised. 6.2:1 / 6.3:1 on canvas.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: The 10px diagnostic strip and legal footnotes on canvas and canvas-raised. 5.4:1 / 5.7:1 on canvas, so it still clears 4.5:1 at that size.

tokens.name: inverse-surface
tokens.usage: The ticker bar and the fill of the primary button. The only surface that flips against canvas.

tokens.name: inverse-ink
tokens.usage: Text and marks on inverse-surface. Never use ink there. 16.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between structural bands: under the nav, above the footer. Not for control borders.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Control and container borders that carry meaning: buttons, inputs, cards. Full ink weight, so it clears 3:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: grid-line
tokens.usage: The engineering grid in the background layer only. Deliberately below the contrast floor because it carries no information.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Live and healthy status only: the footer LED, an uptime dot, a passing check. On canvas and canvas-raised, 5.8:1 / 10.8:1. Never on inverse-surface.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Critical and halted status only: a failed check, a severity badge. On canvas and canvas-raised, 6.4:1 / 7.8:1. Never on inverse-surface.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The focus outline on every interactive element. One value across both themes so it clears 3:1 on canvas (4.5 / 3.7), canvas-raised (4.1 / 3.3) and inverse-surface (3.7 / 4.5).

tokens.name: selection-bg
tokens.usage: Text selection background, paired with selection-ink.

tokens.name: selection-ink
tokens.usage: Text selection foreground on selection-bg.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The hero headline from 768px up. Always uppercase, always two or three lines.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Section openers on long pages. Uppercase.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: The hero headline below 768px, and subsection heads on desktop. Uppercase.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Card and panel headings. The smallest display size; below this use title.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The wordmark in the nav and any inline product name. Uppercase.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every pull request gets reviewed before it merges.
styles.usage: Prose in ink-muted on canvas. Sentence case.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Every pull request gets reviewed before it merges.
styles.usage: Dense prose in cards and captions, in ink-muted.

styles.name: mono-lead
styles.usage: The typewriter sub-headline from 768px up, in ink-muted. Sentence case, no tracking.

styles.name: mono-body
styles.usage: The typewriter sub-headline below 768px, and inline terminal output.

styles.name: mono-label
styles.usage: Every interactive label: nav links, buttons, tabs. Always uppercase.

styles.name: mono-ticker
styles.sample: NO PWN, NO PAY. LEARN MORE
styles.usage: The announcement ticker, in inverse-ink on inverse-surface. Uppercase, tighter tracking than mono-label so long strings stay readable in motion.

styles.name: mono-micro
styles.usage: The diagnostic strip and trial footnotes, in ink-faint. Uppercase. The smallest text in the system; never go below it.

spacing.note: Named by their pixel value, because this system copies paddings exactly rather than snapping to a grid. 14px and 10px are real button paddings, not rounding errors.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between an LED and its label.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Ticker bar vertical padding; gap inside a button between label and arrow.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of the small nav button.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between diagnostic fields in the footer strip.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of the default button.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Footer padding; gap between stacked buttons.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of the small nav button.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Nav bar padding; horizontal padding of the default button; gap between nav links.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Hero padding below 768px; gap between the ticker items.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Space under the hero headline, above the sub-headline block.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Hero padding from 768px up.

radius.note: This system is square. There is no soft corner anywhere except the status LED.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every button, card, input and panel. The default, and stated explicitly so nobody reaches for a soft corner.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: The status LED only. The single exception to the square rule.

border.note: Borders do the work shadows do elsewhere. Every container that needs separating gets a line, not a blur.

tokens.name: border-1
tokens.usage: Control borders, structural band dividers, the background grid line.

tokens.name: border-2
tokens.usage: The typewriter caret, the focus ring and its offset, link underlines.

shadow.note: Hard offsets with zero blur and zero spread. A blurred shadow is wrong in this system.

tokens.name: shadow-brutal
tokens.usage: The hover state of a button or card: paired with a 2px translate up and left, so the element looks lifted off the page.

tokens.name: shadow-brutal-lg
tokens.usage: Resting state of a pricing card or callout that needs to sit proud of the page without a hover.

layout.note: Fixed layout constants. Not a spacing scale.

tokens.name: grid-pitch
tokens.usage: Cell size of the background engineering grid, and the distance it pans per cycle.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the hero content column.

tokens.name: copy-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the sub-headline and CTA block inside the hero.
